crossRefs.note: Saul was told, saying, “Behold, David is at Naioth in Ramah.”
Saul went on this side of the mountain, and David and his men on that side of the mountain; and David hurried to get…
Blessed be Yahweh, who has not given us as a prey to their teeth.
the Lord knows how to deliver the godly out of temptation and to keep the unrighteous under punishment for the day of…
Here I am. Witness against me before Yahweh, and before his anointed. Whose ox have I taken? Whose donkey have I taken?…
Moreover, my father, behold, yes, see the skirt of your robe in my hand; for in that I cut off the skirt of your robe…
He said to David, “You are more righteous than I; for you have done good to me, whereas I have done evil to you.
Yahweh, my God, if I have done this, if there is iniquity in my hands,
Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness. According to the cleanness of my hands, he has recompensed me.
For our boasting is this: the testimony of our conscience, that in holiness and sincerity of God, not in fleshly wisdom…
Beloved, if our hearts don’t condemn us, we have boldness toward God;

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Jonathan
people.line: Eldest son of King Saul and friend of David

people.name: Mizpah
people.line: A city in Benjamin; a place of gathering and judgment

people.name: Naioth
people.line: A place near Ramah where David fled from Saul

translations.web: David fled from Naioth in Ramah, and came and said before Jonathan, “What have I done? What is my iniquity? What is my sin before your father, that he seeks my life?”
translations.bsb: Then David fled from Naioth in Ramah. He came to Jonathan and asked, “What have I done? What is my iniquity? How have I sinned against your father, that he wants to take my life?”
translations.kjv: And David fled from Naioth in Ramah, and came and said before Jonathan, What have I done? what is mine iniquity? and what is my sin before thy father, that he seeketh my life?
translations.asv: And David fled from Naioth in Ramah, and came and said before Jonathan, What have I done? what is mine iniquity? and what is my sin before thy father, that he seeketh my life?
